svg.title: OFF SHFT — proposed garment placements
svg.desc: Technical flat studies of a bone oversized hoodie, slate wide-leg sweatpants and spruce unstructured cap. Exact canonical logo paths. Proposed sizes: hoodie wordmark 80 mm wide, sweatpants symbol 25 mm high, cap wordmark 62.64 mm wide. Illustrations are not to a common scale or production patterns.
